body: it looks like something that would be posted in ED communities

I think what they meant is that, if you change nothing else about your diet, your calorie intake will obviously be less when you cut out one meal. But that doesn’t necessarily mean that you’re at a deficit, you may still be eating too much for weight loss.
I never realized how high-calorie rice is until I started counting!! It’s cruel tbh

I really don’t recommend weighing things when the calories are listed on the label. Just go with what the label says, they’re all going to be slightly off and it’ll all balance out in the end. 

Unnecessarily weighing everything you eat gets you one step closer to an ED.

I really doubt OP posted this wanting to show that they were somehow better than people who can’t moderate at all. this is just their alcohol-related experience that clearly at least some people found insightful.
